notes.title: Demo patch update v0.1.2
notes.notes: [h2]Hey Castaways, [/h2][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has played the Demo already, it’s been such a joy reading your comments and hearing about your favourite parts of the demo, like stacking yuzu on your head![/p][p][/p][p]We are at the halfway point for the public Demo, and we're a week away from Gamescom. We've made a couple of quality-of-life updates thanks to your feedback, so please read below for all the details.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/57f0a069d6bf56957507dcd5d49d186d838376a7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here are the details of the patch update. [/p][p][/p][h3]🐛Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Capy could infinitely duplicate a stick.[/p][/*][*][p]Mac no longer hangs when restarting the game (doesn’t restart yet, but at least it won’t crash!)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a textbox that appears when the game first fades in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items sometimes flickering when getting picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that happened when trying to wear an item immediately after grabbing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Non-US keyboards now display prompts in the correct language, show sprites for input prompts.[/p][/*][*][p]Hats now scale correctly after respawning (no more weird stacking sizes).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced shakiness on the UI and pause screens.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]📋Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Major performance improvements! Game should run smoother and at a higher framerate.[/p][/*][*][p]Added quality and resolution sliders to the pause menu, adjust them to your needs.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees and bushes fade between LODs better for smoother performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you like to [b]report a bug[/b] in-game, when you're in the [b]pause menu[/b], you can select [b]Bug Reporter. [/b]Additionally, we are still collecting player feedback, which you can share  [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxhy7VZTU8-NZcP2X06qfDeDPOf4OzTAgA5rze_YQKRuLoSQ/viewform" style="button" buttoncolor="#20ceb0"][b]here[/b][/url]  or on our [url="https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG"]Discord server[/url]! Once again, thank you so much to everyone for playing our first public Demo, we can't wait for you to play the rest of the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/c23749767e94f63b5f698aa3fad61e00be278193.png"][/img][/p]

[/b]Additionally, we are collecting player feedback, which you can share [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxhy7VZTU8-NZcP2X06qfDeDPOf4OzTAgA5rze_YQKRuLoSQ/viewform" style="button" buttoncolor="#20ceb0"][b]here[/b][/url] or on our [url="https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG"]Discord server[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/c23749767e94f63b5f698aa3fad61e00be278193.png"][/img][/p]
